start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:read-one-workspace-record-by-its-label-and-save-a-change with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and reads [\"page:home\"] and conflict_policy retry."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the records and their versions are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.

2. Say "Run workflow:read-one-workspace-record-by-its-label-and-save-a-change" with store, the labels to read, the writes (each with its expected_identity, or null for a new record) and the conflict_policy. Ask the person before you save a change to a record they have not named.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts; every attempt must come out as the prove step says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the reads and writes through those objects and reads each record back.

worked_examples.title: A record read by its label

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found page:home saved by an earlier run with identity i2 and title B.

worked_examples.title: A stale change is refused under retry
worked_examples.ask: Change the page home to C, from the version I read as i1.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: page:home is at identity i2 after an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: refused [{"label": "page:home", "why": "the record changed since the identity read", "current": "i2"}] and nothing kept for it.

worked_examples.title: A stale change is kept as a conflict under preserve
worked_examples.ask: Keep the change to C from i1 as a conflict, so nothing is lost.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: page:home is at identity i2 after an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept [{"label": "page:home", "conflict": true, "identity": "i3"}] beside the current i2, which stays title B.
